question: What is the total net revenue in the data?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales

question: How many orders are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT invoice_no) FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How many different products were sold at least once?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT product_key) FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How many registered customers placed at least one order?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_key) FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled AND customer_key <> 0

question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount) / count(DISTINCT invoice_no), 2) FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How many units were sold in total?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(quantity) FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How many cancellation invoices are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT invoice_no) FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled

question: What is the total value of all cancellations?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled

question: On how many different days did the shop receive at least one order?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT date_key) FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: What are the gross sales before cancellations?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: Which 5 countries generated the highest net revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS r FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) GROUP BY k.country_name ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 products by units sold?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(quantity) AS u FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled GROUP BY product_key ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 products by net revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) AS r FROM fact_sales GROUP BY product_key ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 5

question: From how many countries did the shop receive orders?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT country_key) FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How much net revenue came from guest checkouts?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_key) WHERE c.is_guest

question: Who are the 5 registered customers with the highest net revenue? Give their customer ids.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, sum(f.line_amount) AS r FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_key) WHERE NOT c.is_guest GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 5)

question: How many orders came from Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) WHERE k.country_name = 'Germany' AND NOT f.is_cancelled

question: What net revenue did the product 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER' generate?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE p.description = 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER'

question: How many products were ordered by customers from more than 20 different countries?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT product_key FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled GROUP BY product_key HAVING count(DISTINCT country_key) > 20)

question: What is the average net revenue per registered customer?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.customer_key), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_key) WHERE NOT c.is_guest

question: What was the net revenue in each year?
gold_sql: SELECT d.year, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) GROUP BY 1

question: What was the net revenue of the best month of 2011?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS r FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011 GROUP BY d.month ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the net revenue in November 2011?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011 AND d.month = 11

question: What was the net revenue in each quarter of 2011?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011 GROUP BY d.quarter

question: By how many percent did net revenue grow from 2010 to 2011?
gold_sql: WITH y AS (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN d.year = 2010 THEN f.line_amount END) AS a, sum(CASE WHEN d.year = 2011 THEN f.line_amount END) AS b FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key)) SELECT round(100 * (b / a - 1), 1) FROM y

question: How many orders were placed on weekends?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.is_weekend AND NOT f.is_cancelled

question: How many orders were placed on the busiest day of the week?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) AS n FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled GROUP BY d.day_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the net revenue in the last 30 days?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.date > DATE '2011-12-09' - INTERVAL 30 DAY

question: How many new customers did the shop get in 2011?
gold_sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT customer_key, min(invoice_ts) AS first_ts FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled AND customer_key <> 0 GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) FROM firsts WHERE year(first_ts) = 2011

question: By how much did net revenue change from September 2011 to October 2011 (October minus September)?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN d.month = 10 THEN f.line_amount ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN d.month = 9 THEN f.line_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011
